title: 938 hardwood flat-cutter feed coupon
note: Four cells down the 36 × 100 top face of a hardwood stick (Y 20 / 36 / 52 / 68), 9 mm text, 1.0 mm deep, on flat-1.0 — the cutter the app recommends for text on this stick (read from the k3 house export, owned cutters only) and the cell size the face allows. The values bracket the SEEDED hardwood 0.8–1.6 row, which is also flat-1.0’s row: its starting F1000 is cut so the readback can adopt it, which is what makes the row measured. The row measures FEED: every other parameter comes from the feeds row unchanged. A 2 mm flat needs ≥13 mm cells and cannot post on the 36 mm face, so it keeps its seeded row.
